default/30408.htm.text: Lionel: Do you know history? Before the Humans came, this island was a holy place for Elves of light. I heard they were powerful enchanters, who communed with spirits. And this ruin was the School of Wizardry built by the Elves for Humans.

links.text: Ask about the School of Wizardry.

default/30408-1.htm.text: Lionel: When they warred with the Orcs, the Elves taught magic to the Humans, who were their allies, to increase their side's strength. Thus, they built the School of Wizardry here, and selected and trained magically talented Humans. However, after the Humans betrayed the Elves, this place was aban…

Q00405_PathOfTheCleric/30408-02.html.text: Lionel: Get out of my sight! How dare you spread false rumors that my books are forbidden!

Q00405_PathOfTheCleric/30408-01.html.text: Lionel: What? The church designated my book as a forbidden book? This is truly too much! Have you read my book?
